items.description: InkBridge transforms any Android device into a high-precision input surface for Linux. Whether you are using a professional S-Pen on a tablet, a "dumb" stylus on a phone, or just your fingertips, InkBridge maps your touch data directly to a virtual Linux digitizer. A SuperDisplay alternative for the Linux ecosystem.
